title: Electric Vehicle Raffle Is Insanely UNDERSOLD. 4,500 Tickets Remain With Less Than 21 Days Before Drawing. Stunning Odds for You. Tickets Benefit Nonprofit.
text:
## 事件
- 清洁能源非营利组织CCAN Action Fund发起电动车抽奖活动，奖品包括Rivian、Lucid、Porsche等品牌的多款电动车型。
- 截至7月10日（距抽奖日7月30日不足三周），仍有超过4,500张门票未售出（总门票上限10,000张），活动处于明显未售罄状态。

## 影响
- 该抽奖的低参与度可能反映美国消费者对高价电动车（如Rivian R1S、Lucid Air、Porsche Taycan）的短期需求或兴趣不及预期。
- 活动旨在推广清洁交通并影响政策，未售罄可能削弱其倡导力度，间接影响电动车政策推进节奏。
- 抽奖奖品覆盖主流及新兴电动车品牌，未售罄现象或侧面暗示部分品牌终端促销与认知度挑战。

## 标的线索
- Rivian（待核实）、Lucid（待核实）、Porsche（待核实）、大众汽车（ID. Buzz，待核实）、现代汽车（Ioniq系列，待核实）、通用汽车（Chevrolet Bolt，待核实）——均为潜在相关品牌，但抽奖活动本身不构成公司基本面变化。
- 电动车充电、电池及清洁能源相关主题板块或受情绪影响（待核实）。

## 待验证
- 抽奖活动实际销售数据及最终参与人数，以判断消费者购买意愿的真实强度。
- 相关车企近期终端销量、库存及订单数据，以核实活动反映的市场趋势是否具有代表性。
- 抽奖活动对CCAN Action Fund倡导工作的实际影响，以及对政策推动的间接作用。

prompt_system:
你是「资讯雷达」投研向改写助手。任务：把用户提供的一篇资讯压成可读的投研草稿。

硬性要求：
1. 严格用下面四个中文小节标题（Markdown ##），顺序固定，每节 1-4 条短句：
## 事件
## 影响
## 标的线索
## 待验证
2. 只客观陈述；不推荐买卖；不预测涨跌；不构成投资建议。
3. 「标的线索」只能写可能相关的公司/板块/主题，并标注「待核实」；没有则写「暂无明确标的线索」。
4. 「待验证」写需要交叉核对的事实或缺口；没有则写「暂无」。
5. 不要输出前后缀寒暄、不要编造文中不存在的数字。

Stunning Odds for You. Tickets Benefit Nonprofit. July 10, 2026 18 seconds Industry Sponsor 0 Comments Support CleanTechnica's work through a Substack subscription or on Stripe . In less than three weeks, a clean energy nonprofit will give away three amazing electric cars. But here’s the problem for the charity: Over 4,500 tickets are still unsold. But that’s a PLUS for you. With fewer tickets sold, your chances of winning a Rivian or Lucid or Porsche EV are AMAZING. And you help a great cause. Get your ticket today! This is the eighth year in a row that the clean energy group, CCAN Action Fund, has raffled an electric vehicle. Each ticket you buy gives you not one, not two, but THREE chances to win. And the drawing is almost here: July 30. CLICK HERE: UNDERSOLD EV RAFFLE WITH STUNNING PRIZES! DRAWING JULY 30 FOR THREE CHANCES TO WIN AN EV. You could be behind the wheel of a stunning new EV by this fall! The first-prize winner will choose between an adventurous Rivian R1S SUV or R1T truck. Or the long-range champion Lucid Air or even the Lucid Gravity. Or, finally, a sporty electric Porsche Macan, Taycan, or Cayenne. The second-prize winner will get to choose between the retro and fun Volkswagen ID. Buzz van, the fan-favorite Hyundai Ioniq family, and the long-awaited Rivian R2. And the third-prize winner will get the keys to a newly relaunched Chevrolet Bolt. Your $200 ticket supports a good cause and earns you three chances to win one of the best electric vehicles on the market, with incredible odds. Even better, state and federal prize taxes are covered! SUPPORT A NONPROFIT FIGHTING FOR CLEAN ENERGY AND TO GET MORE EVS ON THE ROAD. CLICK HERE TO ENTER. Here’s more about the prizes. Ready for adventure? The Rivian truck or SUV might be the electric vehicle for you. The Rivian R1T and R1S both get rave reviews for speed, power, and adventure-ready design. With this EV you can go off-roading or camping with everything you need right inside. Two previous winners of this raffle have chosen the R1T and say it’s everything they hoped for. Or how about a sleek Lucid Air or Gravity? The Air is a long-range champion that can take you from Chicago to Nashville on one charge. With its cutting edge technology, Lucid is quickly becoming a driver favorite. Meanwhile, Porsche needs no introduction. Imagine yourself behind the wheel of an attention-grabbing electric Taycan, Macan, or Cayenne with maximum features for speed and luxury. The first-prize winner will have their pick from these seven extraordinary EVs. The second-prize winner will get to choose between the Volkswagen ID. Buzz—a truly family-friendly vehicle that doubles as an ideal camping companion—the rugged and highly anticipated midsize Rivian R2, or a brand-new car from the Hyundai Ioniq family, a high-tech, high-performance line which has won numerous World Car Awards. And the third-prize winner will receive the newly revamped Chevrolet Bolt RS with all the bells and whistles and a 262-mile range! CLICK HERE TO GET YOUR TICKET TODAY. MORE THAN 4,500 TICKETS UNSOLD. WINNER DRAWN JULY 30. The raffle drawing is almost here! Your $200 ticket could have you driving a new electric car before the end of the year. Anyone can win! Last year’s first-place winner was Tom D. of North Carolina, who won a Rivian R1S. Tom told us he loves how his new electric SUV feels. “The performance and power are unlike anything I’ve ever owned; it’s exciting every time I get behind the wheel.” He’s planning to fill it with “as many adventures as possible. Whether it’s a long road trip, a spontaneous weekend in the mountains of NC, or a relaxing escape to the beach.” Last year’s second-place winner was Justin K. of Minnesota. He won the adorable Volkswagen ID. Buzz and says “driving an EV is just more fun…. Less noise, no exhaust, and WAY more power!” He takes the car on camping trips, and whenever he drives it around, he says he gets a lot of smiles and waves. “People seem to get a real kick out of the unique look of the Buzz.” You could be one of this year’s lucky winners. Your raffle ticket not only gives you THREE chances to win, it makes you a champion for the planet. DRAWING IN LESS THAN THREE WEEKS. GET YOUR TICKET TODAY. With this summer’s wildly volatile gas prices, the raffle and CCAN Action Fund’s clean transportation advocacy work couldn’t be more timely. Every ticket helps CCAN Action Fund advocate for clean energy and clean transportation on Capitol Hill and statehouses. Cars, trucks, and other forms of transportation account for nearly 30 percent of America’s climate pollution. One of CCAN Action Fund’s goals is to get you and everyone else behind the wheel of an electric vehicle. Whether you’re going on an outdoor adventure or cruising city streets, when you sit behind the wheel of an electric vehicle, you’re helping preserve the natural world for generations to come (and avoiding high gas prices forever!). It’s never been clearer — the time to start driving an electric vehicle is NOW. Purchase a ticket today and enjoy the payoff for years (and generations) to come! With 4,500 tickets still unsold out of a maximum of 10,000, your chances of winning are incredible. All raffle proceeds support the CCAN Action Fund team as they advocate for clean energy and transportation. GET YOUR EV RAFFLE TICKET TODAY. DRAWING JULY 30. SUPPORT A NONPROFIT. Raffle will close at 6:00 PM ET on Thursday, July 30, and the winners will be announced at 7:00 PM ET the same day. You must be 18 years old to participate and must purchase the ticket in the United States, must reside in the United States, and must pay taxes in the United States. Vehicle manufacturers are not participants in or sponsors of this raffle. Void where prohibited. See Official Rules HERE .
